stem: What is the clinical definition of chronic pain in children?

options.text: Pain that persists for more than 1 month after an injury
Pain lasting 3 months or more beyond the usual expected healing time
Pain that occurs daily for at least 2 weeks
Any pain associated with hypermobility or regional syndromes
Pain that recurs only during physical activity

explanation: Chronic pain is defined as pain lasting 3 months or more beyond the usual expected healing time.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because 1 month does not meet the usual time-based threshold for chronic pain.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because chronic pain is time-based and is defined as pain lasting 3 months or more beyond the usual expected healing time.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because 2 weeks is far shorter than the standard definition of chronic pain.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because hypermobility and regional syndromes can be associated with chronic pain, but they are not the definition of chronic pain.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because pain that recurs with activity is not the defining feature of chronic pain.

source.hint: Think about the standard quarterly timeframe used to distinguish acute from persistent pain.
